statement: Find a source-specific, independently checkable geometric condition forcing dπ_α:T_{w0}W_α→T_{s0}T to be surjective for the exact rational signed witness category and fixed Hodge branch, without assuming first-order liftability or merely renaming a complete obstruction vanishing condition.
branch_reachable_envelope_status: NORMALIZED_AWAY_AT_FIRST_ORDER: for a complete obstruction theory the kernel is the reachable tangent image; for detector-only data vanishing does not certify reachability.
priority_method_fibres: flag-Hilbert/Chow incidence dimension and smoothness versus Hodge tangent codimension
Lefschetz structures or algebraic correspondences producing actual moving witnesses
normal functions/infinitesimal invariants only with an explicit witness-reachability output
degeneration/specialization under a separately frozen singular/monodromy interface
falsifier: Any proposed H4d1c criterion fails if its conclusion is only detector vanishing, if its hypothesis already assumes tangent surjectivity/liftability, if it loses signed rational coefficients, or if it imports a special-family dimension identity without a transfer witness.
